senses.gloss: (√<he>אג</he>, sec. r. of <cite ref="A00535"><he>אוג</he></cite>, v. <cite ref="A00542"><he>אוּגְיָא</he></cite>, cmp. <cite ref="A00340"><he>אגר</he></cite>, <cite ref="H00156"><he>חגר</he></cite>, <he>עקד</he>)
to twine around, tie up; to close, forbid.
units: <cite ref="Shabbat 60a">Sabb. 60ᵃ</cite> <he>אוֹגֶדֶת בו וכ׳</he> Ar. (ed. <cite ref="A00552"><he>אוגרת</he></cite>, Ms. M. <he>חוגרת</he>) she fastens her hair with it.—
<cite ref="Pesachim 87a:10">Pes. 87ᵃ</cite> <he>בנות ישראל שאוֹגְדוֹת וכ׳</he> ed. (Ms. M. <he>בחורות … שמגידות</he>, v. Hif.) the maidens in Israel who forbid intimacy to their betrothed.
<cite ref="Eruvin 21b:4">Erub. 21ᵇ</cite> <he>ל״א אוגדות</he> ed. (missing in Ms. M.).

senses.gloss: (denom. of אֲגוּדָּה) to form a union or faction.
units: <cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 294">Sifré Deut. 294</cite>, v. Nif. [<cite ref="Bava Batra 14a:13">B. Bath. 14ᵃ</cite> <he>לוחות אוגדות</he>, v. <cite ref="A00335"><he>אָגַר</he></cite> a. <cite ref="A01696"><he>אָכַל</he></cite>.]
<cite ref="Mishnah Maasrot 1:5">Maasr. I, 5</cite> <he>ירק הנֶ׳ משיֵאָגֵד</he> vegetables ordinarily put up in bunches, are subject to tithes from the time they are tied. Y. Erub. III, 20ᵈ top.—
<cite ref="Sifrei Devarim 296:8">Sifré Deut. 296</cite> <he>שלא תאגוד עליך אגודה</he> (read <he>תֵּאָגֵד</he>) no alliance (of the surrounding nations) shall be formed against thee.

units: <cite ref="Eruvin 21b:6">Erub. 21ᵇ</cite>; <cite ref="Pesachim 87a">Pes. 87ᵃ</cite> Ms. M. (play on <he>מגדים</he> <cite ref="Song of Songs 7:14">Cant. VII, 14</cite>) <he>שמֵגִידוֹת וכ׳</he> who forbid &c., v. supra (Rashi: <he>שמַגִּידוֹת</he>, v. <cite ref="A01369"><he>נגד</he></cite>, who announce their menstruation); v. <cite ref="A00241"><he>אָגַד</he> II</cite>.
